HOW WE HELP
Spiritune believes the future of music revolves around you. Your needs, your goals, your emotions, your health. We are reimagining music to address deeper human needs -- such as stress reduction, emotional regulation, productivity and performance. With a scientific, data-driven approach, Spiritune delivers audio and music content to help you manage emotional health. So you can feel well, perform better, and live your best life. Hear what others have to say:
"Spiritune is my new sanctuary on my phone. I think this app is a game changer in self-care." - Ella
"I've often felt that my regular playlists weren't 'in tune' with the way I wanted to feel, especially when I needed them to help me destress. Spiritune's ability to seamlessly propel me into my desired state of mind never fails." - Kaitlyn

WHAT WE DO
- Playlists for work flows, productivity and relaxation
- Music to help you wake up or go to sleep
- Improve your mood and regulate your emotions
- Increase overall wellness and mental health 
- Leverage the latest in neuroscience research to reduce  stress levels and heart rate through sound
- Use the HeathKit API to track Mindful Minutes

WHY IT MATTERS
Sound has a direct impact on our physiological and psychological well-being. Our auditory system is very sensitive, and artificial and distracting sounds can increase our heart rate and stress levels, whether we actively notice this or not. In a world of constant distractions and bombardment of auditory stimuli, an auditory solution has become more important than ever.
Whether you're trying to get into a focused and purposeful work flow or winding down from a long day at work, stress should not get in the way of achieving your goals. Spiritune music is personalized around your needs, your goals, and your health.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
